summaries.Romania: Romania faces a critical energy crisis with the second Cernavodă nuclear reactor shutting down due to historic Danube water levels, while political negotiations on salary law reform collapsed, risking €770M in EU funds.

items.snippet: Nu a existat consens după negocierile de la Cotroceni, de marți, dintre șefii partidelor politice din fosta coaliție de guvernare și președintele Nicușor Dan, au declarat surse politice pentru G4Media. items.title: STAT+: Trump is counting on the health care industry to remake vaccines. It’s pushing back instead
items.snippet: Trump wants to change how American kids are vaccinated, but doctors and the pharma industry aren't on board.
items.line: Trump administration pushes pharmaceutical industry to remake vaccine schedules, but major pharma groups are publicly rejecting the recommendations as scientifically unsound.

items.title: Gemini becomes Google's fastest-growing product ever as it hits 1B users
items.snippet: But will Gemini's surge survive slowing model releases?
items.line: Google's Gemini reached 1 billion monthly active users faster than any Google product ever, making it a critical proving ground for LLM-at-scale business models.

items.title: Cât de mare este riscul de blackout, după oprirea centralei de la Cernavodă. Un oficial le transmite românilor „să stea liniștiți”
items.snippet: Oprirea celui de-al doilea reactor al Centralei Nucleare de la Cernavodă nu duce România în risc de pană de curent la nivel naţional, a afirmat secretarul de stat din Ministerul Energiei Cristian Buşoi, la TVR Info. El transmite că „oamenii trebuie să stea liniştiţi” cu privire la asigurarea consumu
items.line: Danube water levels hit critical thresholds, jeopardizing not just Cernavodă but regional shipping and irrigation across Central Europe.

items.title: Stopping statins in people over 75 at low risk for heart disease didn’t increase deaths
items.snippet: Stopping statins in people over 75 at low risk for heart disease didn’t increase deaths, a new study finds.
items.line: Stopping statins in elderly low-risk patients doesn't increase mortality, challenging widespread prescribing practices and opening questions about deprescribing.

items.title: Trump signs executive order to overhaul pediatric vaccine recommendations
items.snippet: President Donald Trump signed an executive order Monday that calls for reducing the number of required vaccinations for children in a move that backs a revised immunization schedule pushed by the Department of Health and Human Services.
items.line: Trump's executive order to reduce required vaccinations for children bypasses standard FDA review processes and contradicts medical consensus.

items.title: STAT+: Nurses seek a seat at the table as they fight expanding clinical AI
items.snippet: Nurses, who make up the largest part of the health care workforce, say clinical artificial intelligence poses a threat to their jobs, and patients.
items.line: Nurses—the largest healthcare workforce segment—are mobilizing against clinical AI deployment, citing job displacement and patient safety concerns.

items.title: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
items.snippet: For the 14th time, a Google product has hit 1 billion users. Google CEO Sundar Pichai posted on X that a billion people are using Gemini every month, and that Gemini is Google's fastest-growing product ever. A billion users is a huge milestone, but Google isn't the first AI app to hit it. OpenAI's C
items.line: ChatGPT and Gemini both crossed 1B users within weeks, signaling mainstream AI adoption but raising questions about sustainability and moat durability.

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro: Three new camera upgrades are coming
items.snippet: iPhone 18 Pro is just a few weeks away, and rumors indicate it could bring an especially noteworthy batch of camera upgrades. Here are the three main camera features currently rumored.
items.line: iPhone 18 Pro camera upgrades focus on computational photography and low-light performance, reflecting Apple's shift away from raw megapixel competition.

items.title: Apple faces class action lawsuit for ‘fraud’ over iCloud Private Relay flaw
items.snippet:
Security researchers last week revealed a flaw in Apple’s iCloud Private Relay feature. While this is supposed to protect your IP address from the websites you visit, a vulnerability means that it often fails to do so.

items.line: Apple faces class action lawsuit for iCloud Private Relay vulnerability that exposes IP addresses despite encryption promises, raising trust concerns.

items.title: Zoom flaw let an attacker take over your device, including iPhone and Mac
items.snippet: A Zoom vulnerability discovered with the help of an AI tool gave an attacker the ability to remotely execute code on whatever device a meeting participant was using, including both iPhone and Mac …
items.line: Zoom vulnerability discovered with AI assistance allowed attackers to remotely execute code on iPhones and Macs, exposing risks in meeting platform architecture.
